title: aegilops tauschii subsp. strangulata
intro: Aegilops tauschii subsp. strangulata, commonly known as Strangled Spelt or Wild Spelt, is a subspecies of the Aegilops tauschii plant, which belongs to the wheat family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Aegilops tauschii subsp. strangulata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-histaminic activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the properties and potential uses of this plant.
